s001: The tabby breathes slowly and heavily in deep sleep, one ear twitching once; the body stays limp and still. Gentle handheld drift.
s003: The cat chews slowly, head bobbing slightly over the dish; the hand rests still beside it. Gentle handheld drift with a slow push-in.
s005: The fingers hold the lip up steadily; the cat's whiskers twitch and it blinks. Slow handheld push-in on the gums.
s007: The cat chews slowly and carefully, head tilted, pausing between bites; the bowl stays still. Gentle handheld drift.
s008: The ginger cat breathes slowly in its sleep, curled tight, one ear twitching once. Slow handheld push-in.
s009: The cat lies flat, blinking slowly, its paw and the toy mouse staying still; its tail tip twitches once. Gentle handheld drift.
s012: The cat's wide eyes blink slowly and shift side to side in the dark gap, its head pulling back slightly. Slow handheld push-in toward the bed.
s014: The hand holds the tub perfectly steady, its label sharp and readable; nothing else moves. Camera almost locked off with the faintest slow push-in.
s015: The cat lands on the windowsill and settles, tail swinging; the trees outside sway gently in the wind. Gentle handheld drift.
